localFacts.fact: Elgato Spanish setup guide: "Utiliza un trípode con rosca de montaje de ¼\" o ⅜\" que soporte un peso total de al menos 7 kg (15 lb)"; best a professional video tripod or C-stand; unlike the original Prompter, the XL cannot hang from the lens.
Elgato says Camera Hub is no longer supported: Prompter now runs in Elgato Studio, and Camera Hub scripts import in one step. The English post's step 6 still says Camera Hub.

Elgato (ES): the XL needs a USB-C port with 15 W, text stays readable up to 4,6 m; the XL "puede resultar inestable cuando está completamente montado": spread the legs and add sandbags or counterweights at the base.
NEEWER's EU store spec table lists the TP75 at 8,0 kg maximum load (the US page and the EU page text say 10 kg); even 8 kg still clears Elgato's 7 kg minimum.
Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm: none of these video tripods (79 to 94 cm folded) fits, so a Prompter tripod goes in checked baggage.
Spanish terms: trípode de vídeo, rótula fluida / cabeza fluida, media bola de 75 mm, contrapeso, araña intermedia, soporte C (C-stand), placa de liberación rápida.
CineD (Spanish edition): the Prompter XL weighs about 3,4 kg including the bracket and needs a sturdy tripod or a light stand.

localPainPoints.pain: The fully built XL is top-heavy and the head tips forward.
localPainPoints.fix: Slide the plate back until the head holds with the tilt lock open (English step 4), spread the legs, sandbag the base; or the counterbalanced Manfrotto 502.

quotes.text: El Prompter XL puede resultar inestable cuando está completamente montado.

localPainPoints.pain: A light basic tripod cannot hold front-heavy weight and the head sinks forward.
localPainPoints.fix: Skip travel and basic photo tripods; Elgato asks for 7 kg, so pick a video tripod rated 8 kg or more.

localPainPoints.pain: Front weight makes a 4 kg rig feel far heavier than its scale weight.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick a tripod rated 8 kg or more (English post's load math: 14 lb = about 80% of 8 kg).

quotes.text: The full rig is around 9 LB, but because of the prompter XL's front weight, it behaves more like 12–14 LB when mounted.

localPainPoints.pain: Users still look for Camera Hub, which Elgato no longer supports.
localPainPoints.fix: Load the script in Elgato Studio; Camera Hub scripts import in one step.

localGain.point: Elgato's own Spanish wording of the 7 kg / ¼" or ⅜" rule, plus 15 W USB-C and 4,6 m reading distance.
Current software: Prompter now runs in Elgato Studio (Camera Hub no longer supported), which the English post misses.
Honest load note: NEEWER's EU spec table gives the TP75 8,0 kg, not 10 kg; still above Elgato's 7 kg.
Maker metric figures first (TP74 86-187 cm, 91 cm folded; TP75 89-189 cm, 93 cm folded; Manfrotto 157 cm column down).
